title: orch factory ticket data: ext.factory
description: Owned by the factory add-on (its ticket_ext; the add-on ships a byte-identical copy). The core never reads it. A CACHE for the dashboard and the manager: every authority decision (start, stops, changes, autopilot) is derived again from the ticket's human-answered factory:* questions and the add-on journal, never from these fields (contracts/addons/factory/README.md, Authority). On an order (parent ticket) role = order; on a crew sub-ticket role = crew; on an ask sub-ticket (one stop shared with another workspace for its view) role = ask.

role.description: order = the parent ticket; crew = a sub-ticket doing one proposal task; ask = a small sub-ticket of the order carrying one stop's line and the ticked items to another workspace's group (the group card is built from this ticket, never from the order). Asks are derived from these sub-tickets; the order keeps no list of them.

kind.description: Order only. run = a normal Factory run; autopilot = an autopilot order (the agent may decide routine/taste items itself while its grant is valid).

stage.description: Order only. draft = idea being polished; proposed = a Run proposal waits for Start; running = the crew works; waiting = a stop or change waits for the owner; shipped / cancelled = finished.

idea_box.description: Order only. Filed by a person's click in the idea box: draft v1 is the person's own words, so the draft waits for the person only from v2 (the agent's).

hash.description: sha256 of the frozen proposal file.

line.description: Order only. The stages of the started proposal with their state (for the stage bar).

stop.description: true = the owner decides at the end of this stage.

by.description: Who answered the stop (agent:factory only under an autopilot grant).

crew.description: Order only. Crew sub-ticket ids (their parent is this order).

active_min_used.description: Measured agent run time on this order and its crew; waiting for the owner never counts.

api_usd_target.description: A planning target, not a cap (no usage contract yet).

tiny.description: Order only. Small changes the manager did without a change proposal (cap: 3 changes or 30 min).

grant_until.description: Autopilot order only: when its grant ends (display; checked against the journal and the answer).

order.description: Crew and ask: the order (same as the ticket's parent).

task.description: Crew only: the proposal task slug this sub-ticket does (one sub-ticket per order + task).

crew_role.description: Crew only: builder, reviewer, writer, designer, checker …

agent.description: Crew only: the adapter or [agents.<name>] entry its runs use.

stop.description: Ask only: the stop number (stops/<order>/s<N>.json) this ask is about.

handover.description: Crew only, for a task handed to another workspace: a display cache of the delegate's state (derived again from the relay task status).

name.description: The workspace's display name at hand-over time.

state.description: Relay task status; review = ready for review at the other workspace; not_needed = the owner accepted 'Do it here instead' and the other side was told.
